title: Email Addresses
description: A list of email addresses with exactly one marked default. For single-email fields reference EmailAddress/v1 instead. Minimum 1, maximum 5 entries; exactly one entry must be marked default when the list is non-empty. NOTE: the 'exactly one default' constraint is cross-field and is enforced by the SchemaRefResolver at validation time (Feature 103 T039-T041), not by JSON Schema alone — the resolver rejects payloads where zero or more than one item has isDefault=true.

x-sections.title: Email Addresses
x-sections.description: You can add up to 5 email addresses. Pick one as the default — we'll use it for primary correspondence.
